scope: All root scenario and Torenthia pages; related live explainers, discovery data and authoring guidance audited as dependencies. Historical constitutional editions and dated audit notes are evidence, not current instructions.

entries.decision: Removed treaty twelve-month renewal, twelve-hour notification, ninety-day constitutional wind-down and 180-day constitutional report claims. Retained deployment/notice/judgment/ceasefire/report dates and treaty trigger review; supplied lawful case-specific schedules. Clarified Senate review, Assembly budget origination and distinct alert-posture authority.
Removed residual repealed funding-floor certification and legislative pay penalty; retained seventeen-day impasse and automatic continuity.
Assigned spending authority to Legislature; located retained fiscal certification framework in statute and preserved treaty dispute/Day 167 law.

Corrected mandatory response, nonbinding findings, absence of fixed Pass/Fail standards and suspension approval; retained finding and response two months later. Removed residual implication that the Legislature cannot contest a published Monitor standard or ignore response duty. Removed voluntary-but-unconstitutional Monitor verification gate before tabling.
Made vacancy the explicit sixty-day trigger; distinguished Elections Panel lottery administration from JMC fallback selection and remainder-term confirmation.
Preserved jurisdiction-stripping holding and remand while removing superseded general Supreme Court original jurisdiction over federal statutes.
Timely Supreme Court nomination and Senate rejection, temporary service, pool eligibility and subsequent nomination remain compatible; no missed-vote fallback is inferred from rejection.
Preserved parallel citizen/electoral enforcement, 41% access finding and invalidation; corrected judicial route.
Assigned ordinary JM lottery to Elections Panel; retained incumbent after failed advance confirmation, acting authority at expiry, successive failed/confirmed results and remainder term.

Corrected Inhabitant rights attachment; preserved ordinary week and asylum/civic-service story. Corrected below-floor adequacy claim and independent judicial asylum forum; retained four-person ordinary week. Assigned health administration/fiscal-capacity audit to EM rather than LM; preserved legislative-record and political-accountability strand.
Replaced obsolete repeal exclusions and turnout floor, restored filing-time eligibility review and statutory petition periods; retained repeal/re-enactment result.
Distinguished final recall decision from steps initiating review; retained later judicial remedy and two-seat continuity.

Applied absolute prohibition on renewal/substantial repetition and expedited review; preserved Day 14 expiry, Day 17 repeat, Day 19 judgment and discrimination remedy. Removed obsolete sixty-day/2/3 re-declaration escape. Synchronized social descriptions and visible subtitle with current non-repetition mechanism.
Removed obsolete exclusive review wording while preserving State discretion, vested federal residency and discrimination remedy.
Removed independence-as-exemption rationale; distinguished express direct administration, continuing federal assistance duty and available interim judicial relief.

Rebuilt audit/admission mechanism around all-three-findings completion, affirmative chamber decisions, inconclusive votes, exclusive transfer and judicial enforcement. Retained Year 1–3 qualification sequence and eventual Statehood; removed two-Monitor automatic results and delay-induced lapse.
Judicial misconduct is distinguished from disagreement with a ruling. Both-chamber 2/3 removal and absence of a prerequisite Monitor finding remain compatible.
Corrected staff-disclosure protection and confidentiality limits; retained suppressed audit, two-page disclosure, court release and non-retaliation outcome.
Named-successor constructive replacement, full-seated Assembly majority, vacated seat and ordinary service limits remain compatible.

Removed MA deficit threshold/constitutionally required balance plan and obsolete Severe Revenue Contraction exception to social guarantees; retained crisis, certifications and payments. Retained annual historical audit without inventing a constitutional annual-fund-audit requirement.

Preserved Year 14 departure, twelve-month notice, grid settlement and dual citizenship; located notice period in the compact and corrected sovereignty/rights/citizenship references. Located termination period in compact and corrected membership/citizenship reference.
Removed residual retired-range citation and misleading lawful-direction claim; preserved refusal, judicial decision and failed constructive replacement.

Retained canonical merger countries, people, Day Zero, twenty-four-month schedule and first twelve years; made phases and extra turnout terms founding arrangements, replaced phase-gated activation with individual capability, updated registers/rights forum and removed repealed institutional maxima. Synchronized provision-tag names with candidate; substantive prose reviewed separately.
Updated State-force call-up, individual capability transfer and permissible caretaker legislation; retained Day 41 invasion, election and conversion-window story.
Made vacancy arise from resignation rather than ordinary Assembly election; added repeat fallback after no winner under current §2.6.a(6).

Reworked fiscal finding/response duties, statutory ninety-day schedule, independent fiscal analysis and continuing enforceable rights. Preserved gaps, legislation, dates and eventual recovery; removed forced legislative remedy and rights-reduction exceptions.

Updated founding period, direct-State alternative, compact-based termination procedure, current expedited rights route and legislative Statehood determinations; retained Corrin decision and improper-inducement episode.
Preserved ordinary move and voting chronology; separated identity/eligibility registry from NVS, reinforced single voting citizenship and retained Article I limits on State procedures.
Statutory nomination period within constitutional ceiling, Senate deadline, automatic public route, ballot-certification cutoff and temporary continuity remain compatible.
Assigned Elections Panel oversight to Judicial Monitor mandate, not Judicial Monitor pool eligibility section.
Corrected judicial forum and Elections Panel’s independent duty to determine compliance; retained State redraw and election outcome.
Retained reconsideration notice, expansion and later fiscal warning; located numerical balance target and reporting consequence in statute.
Located detailed removal procedure and appeal in applicable law while preserving Article I review, appointed counsel, lawful refusal and later removal outcome.
Clarified that re-qualification requires affirmative legislative audit determinations, not publication of favorable findings alone.
Preserved sovereignty/anti-commandeering holding; replaced superseded quotation and moved universal audit obligation to §15.2(7).
Corrected Monetary Authority authority and retained lawful reorganization/independence distinction.
25-year classification plus single five-year extension, nonbinding EM evidence, portion-specific judicial release and automatic declassification publication remain compatible.
Three-stage independence thresholds, recusals, no-coercion rule, national participation and separation-agreement effect remain compatible.

Reworked restoration around legislative audit determinations; identified alternative timeline; corrected internally contradictory Senate term/seat history. Synchronized provision-tag names with candidate; substantive prose reviewed separately.

Preserved Lena’s injury and successful judicial remedy; located specific evidentiary and in-camera procedure in statute rather than removed constitutional detail, updated counsel subsection and retained uncertainty over re-entry classification.
Removed initiative turnout floor; identified petition and review periods as statutory; preserved 63%/57% result and Supreme Court severance through appellate review.

Replaced removed second-renewal/mandatory reconstruction-plan mechanism with review of mission expansion under §§2.2, 12.2 and 14.2. Retained URL, Halvern/Josk setting and Year 6–12 sequence; archived exact old source and hash. Separated command, Senate review, legislative authorization, Assembly-originated appropriations and orderly withdrawal.
Corrected initiative screening, no-turnout thresholds, appellate jurisdiction, severability rationale and amendment review; preserved 64%/58% vote and limited invalidation.

Removed repealed Trust referendum period/turnout and annual land-audit mandate; preserved dual approvals and failed 54.1% removal vote. Corrected withdrawal initiation as Legat notice followed by Senate affirmation.

Corrected removal initiators, no-turnout referendum, continuing duty after missed deadline, suspension approval and permanent-incapacity route; retained Day 74 failed vote, 38% support and 61% participation. Synchronized provision-tag names with candidate; substantive prose reviewed separately.

Replaced Monitor-count failure rule with legislative determinations; preserved Year 11/13/15 failures and Year 15 Provisional decision. Removed compulsory/repeating devolution referendum; retained Year 17 rejection as voluntary State choice. Synchronized provision-tag names with candidate; substantive prose reviewed separately.
Death triggers full succession immediately; NRS recording does not create authority. Original timestamps and later publication remain compatible.
Synchronized provision-tag names with candidate; substantive prose reviewed separately.

Reworked renewed incapacity to six-month maximum and fresh 2/3 determination; removed legislative extension and thirty-day rule; corrected declination timing, subsection numbers and contradictory second-determination date.
Distinguished non-refoulement from court-granted asylum and legal residency; retained fraud, protection, release and continued-lawfulness history.
Corrected suspension clock from return date and framed formula conflict as legislative reconciliation; discretionary investment is distinguished from veto-exempt constitutional implementation.
Distinguished votes cast from active-ballot percentages; kept 61.8% waiver result by specifying no exhaustion in this hypothetical count.
Corrected protected-rights Popular Ratification and judicial review; retained Year 18 fourth-amendment case and partial void result.
Retained canonical bid, cost, two challenges, award and capitals; made thirty-day limit statutory and restored general legality review under current §18.2.
